pages.text: Refines raw Acheronite Shards into $(bold)Refined Acheronite$().

pages.title: Inputs
pages.text: $(li)2 Shards: 1 Refined Acheronite$(li)4 Spent Lattice: 1 Sealed Lattice$(br2)Progress survives outages and mode changes.

pages.title: Modes
pages.text: Click the mode to cycle:$(li)$(bold)Auto$(): power first, then heat$(li)$(bold)Electric$(): power only$(li)$(bold)Heat$(): saves power

pages.title: Heat Mode
pages.text: $(bold)Orbital Scan #0074$()$(li)Below $(bold)Y=0$()$(li)Lit Thermal Heater or $(l:advanced/geothermal_core)Geothermal Core$(/l) within $(bold)8 blocks$()$(br2)10 s per item.

pages.title: Electric Mode
pages.text: Link it with the $(l:power/binder)Binder$(/l). It works at any height and needs the full $(bold)25 kW$(): about 6.7 s per item.$(br2)One Core's 20 kW isn't enough alone. No idle draw.

pages.title: Waste Heat
pages.text: $(danger)Electric refining dumps 6.25 kW into the room.$() Plan $(l:heating/heat_vent)vents$(/l).$(br2)Refining is loud in either mode. Architects hear it.

pages.title: Acheron Forge
pages.text: Obsidian frame, raw shards, a Thermal Core.$(br2)$(flavor)Theoretical. You are the field test. Do not lick the forge.$()
